verdict.rationale: Alma is a technology-enabled immigration law firm with a company-facing case-management system, so an API reference is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence shows no API reference, interactive explorer, or runnable examples, and probes of every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file describes the firm but documents no API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
